doc.type: Actual queried trend dimension for trace.
doc.data: Trend data array. For monthly dimension: flat key-value array, even index = month yyyyMM, odd index = value. For BsrRank: structured object array grouped by subcategory, each contains node_id, name, rank array [{date,value}]. Price / ListPrice / SalesAmount values are in USD (main currency unit, not cents). Value -1: no data/rank for that period.
